title: Lumen Rally
summary: GPT-6 Astra leads, with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash subagents.
description: GPT-6 Astra leads, with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash subagents. A browser kart racer made from the same game brief as the other 3 entries in this comparison. Each build started from scratch. Astra used medium reasoning and DeepSeek used max reasoning throughout.
